features.title: Start from just ₹100
features.description: Buy 24K digital gold in fractional grams — no minimum grams, no fixed schedule. Invest any amount, any day.

features.title: Live market rate
features.description: Every purchase is executed at the day's published gold rate, so you always know exactly how many grams you own.

features.title: Secured in your account
features.description: Your gold balance is recorded against your account and statements are available on request — track your grams in real time.

features.title: Redeem after 1 month
features.description: After a short 1-month lock-in, convert your holdings to coins or bars, or sell back at the prevailing rate.

steps.title: Register
steps.description: Submit your details below — our team verifies your KYC and activates your account within 24 hours.

steps.title: Invest
steps.description: Transfer any amount from ₹100 upward. Your grams are credited at the day's rate.

steps.title: Track & redeem
steps.description: Watch your gold grow with every top-up. Redeem as coins or bars, or sell back after the lock-in.
